settings.feedsHint: One feed per line: Name | Source | Forum | Minutes | Label | Options. Source: an RSS / Atom address (https://…) or steam:<game id> (730 = CS2, 10 = CS 1.6). Forum: its name or id. Options: translate (from English), full (only if the source allows republishing), pin, lock. Lines starting with # are ignored.
settings.maxPerRun: News posted per run, per feed
settings.maxPerRunHint: The rest wait for the next run.
settings.windowHint: For example 08-23 (from 8:00 to 23:00) or 22-06. Empty = any time.
settings.timezone: Time zone of the posting hours
settings.timezoneHint: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Bucharest.
settings.excerptCharsHint: Without “full”, the bot posts only the title, the excerpt, the image and the source link.
settings.steamApiHint: The official API by default. Change it only for a proxy of it.

acp.title: News bot
acp.intro: The feeds checked by the community bot. New stories become bot topics, each one only once.
acp.empty: No feeds yet. Add them in the plugin settings.
acp.ran: The run started for {feeds} feeds; the result shows here in a few moments.
